_: The realm at map zoom (docs/review/realm-map.md; art target 02-realm; CK3's map modes, Total War's campaign map). politics: the map zoom turns the political map on (look.json politics; its wash and border wait for map height). marks: the mid zoom's map marks over the 3D land (map_marks.gd), fading in with camera distance from `from` to `to` (the painted overview takes over at 60). banner: an army's standard on screen in pixels (pole height, flag width and height, sigil size, men plate font); the same figure on the overview, scaled by `overview.banner_scale`. line: what a host's standard says under the pointer (host: its house and men; bound: where Freeciv sends it, {to} the town there or field; ease: when it stands; plate: the men plate at its foot); its men are its companies' own, by kind and health (bridge hosts.js menOf). siege: crossed swords in a red ring over a besieged town (ring radius px, pulse seconds, colour). route: a host on the march, a dashed line to where it's bound (dash, width px, arrow px, colour). labels: town names at the mid zoom (map_labels.gd): a town is named up to camera distance far_base + size * far_per_size (seats and the King's own always), its name grows font_per_size px per size over font_base, at most font_most. relief: the land's hills and mountains shaded at the map's height (land3d.gd; target 02-realm; pass 2159: the map read flat): strength (0 none), light (the direction it is shaded from: low from the north-west); overview: the painted map past distance 60 (realm_map.gd): wash, the house colours over the painting (was 0.2); border_px, the seam's width; border_dark, its dark core's share; town_r_base / town_r_per_size / town_r_seat, a town's mark radius; font_base / font_per_size / font_seat, its name; named_size, the smallest town named at the whole-realm zoom (all named past named_zoom); banner_scale; match: the painting opens at the scale the 3D camera saw, at most match_most of the whole realm's height, then eases out to ease_to. marks.unrest: a town in uproar (the bridge's riot, Freeciv's civil disorder, or a rising; map_look.unrest): its ember ring's radius in pixels, how much wider for a rising, the flicker's period in seconds, the colour.
